__NOTOC__ Severance is a two-handed axe with a huge bonus to strength, stamina and increased chance to critical strike. It is ideal for non-fury warriors who are acting as damage dealers, though paladins and enhancement shamans with the ability to wield two-handed weapons may also put it to good use.

A set bonus is some type ability, attribute, power or spell bonus that gets added when a character has some specified number of items from a set (usually armor) equipped. Sets can have multiple set bonuses depending on the minimum number of items in the set to activate the bonus (i.e. (2) Set: bonus, (4) Set: bonus).
Shadowmoon Weapon Masters are fel orcs of the Shadowmoon clan that can be found in Black Temple. Killing one of them grants 15 reputation with the Ashtongue Deathsworn.
Shadowy Tormentors are shades found in the Realm of Shadows while on the quest Into the Realm of Shadows, and at Agmar's Hammer on the quest The Power to Destroy.
Shale Greyfeather is a Highmountain tauren bow vendor standing next to Losro Greyfeather on the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

The Shattered Axe is the name of a weapon shop in Orgrimmar, owned and maintained by Urtharo. He sells various normal quality weapons. During the Cataclysm, the building was destroyed. Urtharo has since set up a small stand on the western wall outside the Grommash Hold.
Shield Slam is a Level 3 warrior ability. It is a powerful attack with a shield which causes a high amount of damage and generates Rage.
Sheldon Von Croy is a Forsaken cloth armor vendor located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.

Sky-Master Maxxor is a mok'nathal flight master located at Mok'Nathal Village in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Skyguard Handler Irena is an human located at Skyguard Outpost in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Upon achieving honored reputation with the Sha'tari Skyguard, she serves as a free-of-charge flight path between the Skyguard Outpost and Blackwind Landing in Terokkar Forest, on the outskirts of Skettis. Her counterpart in Terokkar is Skyguard Handler Deesak.
Skyguard Nether Rays are nether rays located at Blackwind Landing in Terokkar Forest, in Shattrath City, and in Blade's Edge Mountains. One is found with the Skyguard Handler.

Soran's Leather and Steel Armory is an armor shop in Orgrimmar, selling various armor types of Common quality, ranging from Cloth to Mail. The building was destroyed during the Shattering and it's occupants have moved into other shops.
Soulshatter Arrows were never made available, although the Soulshatter Bow shoots arrows with the same name.

Steelscale Crushfish is an obscure weapon that is obtained from fishing, however it is very, very rare. It has been known to be caught in Wetlands, Hillsbrad Foothills, and Darkmoon Island. One of the highest chances you might have to catch this fish is to cast off of the dock in Southshore. Catching this fish meets the criteria for One That Didn't Get Away.
Strange Crystals drop from various types of colossi in Outland, including: * Morcrush in Blade's Edge Mountains * Son of Corok in Shadowmoon Valley * Farahlon Breaker in Netherstorm

Sundered Souls are ghosts of ogres slain by Skulloc Soulgrinder found at Soulgrinder's Barrow in the Blade's Edge Mountains. They attempt to destroy the Soulgrinder during the quest Into the Soulgrinder.

Sunn Ragetotem is a tauren staff vendor located on the High Rise in Thunder Bluff. She is a member of the Ragetotem tribe. Her shop is advertised as selling Rainsticks. She attended the feast for the Highmountain tauren in the city. She was seen speaking with Sura Wildmane. She was later trapped by the Void.
__NOTOC__ Suspicious City Guards are humans located in Stormwind City only during The Unseen Blade. Some of them are Veiled Hand cultists.
Swift Flight Bracers are mail wrist armor with ranged Attack Power primarily for hunters.
Sydney Upton is a staff vendor located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.

Talgaiir the Ironrender is a draenei briefly seen, surrounded by dead Iron Horde tropps in as an Exotic Weapon Collector before the city is taken over by the . He is also seen at the Lunarfall in as a vendor in Trading Post.

Tank swap is term used for a boss in a raid which requires two tanks to beat. This mechanic usually comes into play when a debuff on the tank makes it impossible to keep tanking. This might include some detrimental effects like immense damage over time, reducing the tank's healing and survivability, or even killing the tank outright after certain conditions. To allow for the original tank to reset their debuff, the other tank taunts the boss to take aggro off the first tank. There a variety of possible mechanical variations. The Dark Defiance is a Forsaken battleship, and part of the Windrunner Fleet, located off the Derelict Strand in the Howling Fjord. It is anchored behind The Windrunner and is under attack by North Fleet Marines. The only way to board the ship is to fly onto it, as unlike the other two boats, it is not docked on the island.

The Fourth Prophecy can be found in Grishnath of Blade's Edge Mountains. When approached: :The Voice of the Raven God whispers: The raven was struck down once for flying too high, unready. The eons have prepared the Dark Watcher for its ascent, to draw the dark cloak across the horizon.

The Impervious is a Horde zeppelin that was part of the air fleet formed to fight in the Twilight Highlands along with Spear of Durotar, Heart of Orgrimmar , The Indomitable, The Skyshredder, and Garrosh's Airship. It was destroyed by the twilight dragonflight before it could reach the naval fleet off the west coast of Dragonmaw Port.
wielding The Untamed Blade.]] The Untamed Blade is a two-handed sword, which is great for warriors and paladins, that procs a powerful strength buff.

Thunderlord Dire Wolves can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains. A large wolf pack brought from Azeroth, they are the mounts, sentries and friends of the orcs of Thunderlord Stronghold, and under the leadership of den mother Rema they are the defenders of the Jagged Ridge. As a result the Alliance poaches them, and the Horde seeks to strengthen them.

Tier 16 is the armor set associated with Patch 5.4.0. It is obtained from the Siege of Orgrimmar raid. All the tokens are turned in to Nadina Stargem or Thelett Shaleheart (for Normal mode), Blizzix Sparkshiv or Welbiz Cheerwhistle (for Raid Finder), Ki'agnuu or Clarice Chapmann (for Heroic mode), and Tu'aho Pathcutter or Lorry Warmheart (for Mythic mode) in Shrine of Two Moons or Shrine of Seven Stars.
__NOTOC__ Timothy Weldon is a Forsaken heavy armor vendor located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

Trap Launcher was a level 48 hunter ability. While active, it allowed the hunter to launch any trap up to 40 yards away, removing the need to get into melee range to place them. This ability was off the global cooldown.
Treasured Coin is used for increasing the Artifact Power of your Artifact weapon. It increases the Artifact Power by 10.

Sometimes, alchemical or magical alteration can lead those berserkers to become dire trolls. Members of other "wild" races such as the vrykul can also become berserkers, but in these cases they are generally plainly enraged melee warriors instead. The Bleeding Hollow clan was also known to create dire orc berserkers in blood rituals. __NOTOC__ The Twilight Base Camp was one of four Twilight's Hammer camps in Silithus. During the Call of the Scarab micro-holiday, creatures scale with the player from level 60 to max level. The camp, alongside the majority of settlements in Silithus, was destroyed at the end of the third invasion of the Burning Legion when Sargeras tried to destroy Azeroth.

Twilight's Run is a cave filled with members of the Twilight's Hammer Cult at the base of Staghelm Point in northern Silithus. During the Call of the Scarab micro-holiday in late January, the Twilight creatures scale with player level and drop event-related items. After Sargeras destroyed Silithus, the cave's entrance vanished. It was likely buried by an avalanche, as the mountains around the border of the zone shifted. The Alliance built a base not far from where the entrance once was.

__NOTOC__ The Twilight Tome is an ancient book used by the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore. It is written in an ancient language, and illustrated by a master artist. You can't read it as the text twists into grotesque shapes, if you try it. When bringing the Insane Scribbles to Onu he senses the chaotic, primal magic of the old ones in it. Although written by elves, it is heavily cursed and tainted by the corruption of the Twilight's Hammer, but it seems the cult is using ancient elven magic to bring their old masters back to Azeroth.

Twilight Bulwark is a large Twilight's Hammer outpost located on a shelf in southern Thousand Needles. It overlooks what used to be the Screeching Canyon until it was flooded. The ramp that leads up into the outpost was made during the Cataclysm, it is part of the wall of the mountain that collapsed upon the cavern known as Roguefeather Den, destroying the entrance and possibly the whole cavern itself. The outpost has three leaders: Commander Fastfuse, Codemaster Deethuk, and Elementalist Starion, with them gone the combined forces of Freewind Post will be able to clear out the cultists from here. The Understone Breach is an area on the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain that is created when Dargrul uses the Hammer of Khaz'goroth to destroy the nearby Snowmane Village. A portal to Neltharion's Lair is found inside the cave in the center of the breach, but the entrance is blocked when Dargrul retreats inside and causes a rockslide during The Underking, forcing adventurers seeking entrance into the lair to use a hidden side entrance further west instead.

==In Warcraft I== This ritual invokes the recipient with a mystic armor of invulnerability. Weapons will have their effects dissipated when striking the wearer. This armor is constructed from the souls of the damned, and they absorb the pain that any blows would normally inflict upon the wearer. The price that is exacted from those who are bestowed with this invulnerability is a high one, however, for they must sacrifice a portion of their soul to act as a magnet to bind these lost souls to themselves. After some time, this binding will weaken, and those who make up the armor will be released back into their eternal torment.
Unoke Tenderhoof is a tauren flight master located at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
The Unused Axe of the Executioner drops from the Shattered Hand Executioner in Shattered Halls. This item only drops on heroic mode.

Unstable Powerful Weapon Crystals are what remains of Powerful Weapon Crystals, which can no longer be crafted. Prior to Shadowlands, using this item "restored" it into a Weapon Crystal and 25 Sorcerous Air.

Vanquisher's Hammer is the paladin class ability of the Necrolord Covenant. It's available to all paladins who join the Necrolords. This ability is also temporarily available during the Maldraxxus portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Champion the Cause and lasts until you finish the Maldraxxus storyline.

Varo'then's Magical Blade is Varo'then's sword that he charges with arcane and fire magic, but eventually drops on the ground after being defeated during the Mannoroth and Varo'then encounter in the Well of Eternity. Adventurers can then throw it at Mannoroth to inflict damage.

Veil Lashh is an arakkoa settlement located in southwestern Blade's Edge Mountains. It is surrounded by the Living Grove, and is situated just south of Sylvanaar. Circles of power are used by the Lashh'an living there.
Veil Vekh is located in the southern part of Vekhaar Stand in Blade's Edge Mountains, home to the Vekh'nir tribe of arakkoa. Circles of power are used by the Vekh'nir living there.
Vengeful Gladiator's Idol of Tenacity is a PvP reward, and can be purchased for from in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Vengeful Gladiator's Totem of Indomitability was a PvP reward, and could be purchased for from in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Vibro Sword is an main hand sword. It gives bonuses to intellect, spell critical, spell power, and mana regeneration. It has a semi-transparent look.

A wand is a ranged weapon that causes Arcane, Fire, Frost, Nature, Shadow or (in rare cases) Holy or Physical damage. They may be used by priests, mages, and warlocks. There is no restriction on the damage type that can be wielded and used; you can use wands outside your native damage capabilities. No class that can use wands needs to train to use them. Wands can autoshoot. Wands will work at both ranged and melee distance. Wands are not affected by disarm effects, and they cannot be interrupted except by a disable. Shooting a wand does not require mana, and it does not count as casting, which means that mana regeneration occurs normally. This also means that they do not receive benefit from
Walter Ellingson is a Forsaken heavy armor vendor located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

A wagon is a four or more-wheeled, big, open vehicle for transporting heavy loads. In general, beasts of burden such as horses, kodo beasts, nightsabers, clefthooves or ettins draw it. They can also be powered by magic. Wagons are heavy. The vulpera live in wagons. A wagon-cage is a cage designed to hold and transport a small number of prisoners over long distances. Wagons for human transportation are called carriages, stagecoaches, and palanquins.

The Zandalar Illusionist's Mantle is a cloth shoulder armor for mages which gives a bonus to stamina, intellect, spirit, and overall magical power. The robe is part of the armor set called the Illusionist's Attire.

Body Shield is an inherited MEC Trooper ability in XCOM: Enemy Within. This particular ability is gained if the soldier was originally a Heavy.

The Darklance is a primary weapon in the XCOM 2 expansion, War of the Chosen. It is the signature weapon of the Chosen Hunter. The Darklance comes equipped with 4 superior weapon upgrades, one more than the maximum number of upgrades available to XCOM's weapons. The Darklance requires only one action to fire, allowing the user to move/reload and shoot in the same turn. This allows the wielder to be significantly more mobile without sacrificing damage. This pairs well with abilities like Death From Above, as the killing shots from height advantage refund one action, allowing the soldier to fire again and repeatedly, similar to the Serial ability.

However, they make up for these deficiencies with being deployed in endless numbers during the mission. Shock-Absorbent Armor is an inherited MEC Trooper ability in XCOM: Enemy Within. This particular ability is gained if the soldier was originally an Assault.

Vault is an ability granted by the Icarus Armor and possessed by some enemies (MECs; Leap for Chryssalid, Faceless). Vault allows a soldier to move to any elevated surface within movement range without the need to use a ladder or other climbing utility. Vault is a passive ability that does not require activation and has no cooldown. It triggers automatically and does not break concealment, provided the soldier does not traverse an observed tile.

Ebon Watch is a minor encampment of the Knights of the Ebon Blade in Zul'Drak. During the war against the Lich King, the Ebon Blade established Ebon Watch as a small outpost in Zul'Drak, and from there conducted their own operations — and some in cooperation with the Argent Crusade. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that while most of the death knights have moved on to fight in the other wars, Ebon Watch remained out of an abundance of caution for years. That caution turned out to be rather prescient when Sylvanas Windrunner destroyed the Helm of Domination and the Scourge ran amok once more.
